title: Scarab2233s End Hut
description: This mod adds a little end hut that will give you gun powder for rockets and make the end not so plane without changing the game completely
body:
Ender Hut adds a rare and immersive structure to the world of Minecraft, bringing life and lore to the vast emptiness of the End dimension. Hidden among the floating islands, the Ender Hut is a small but mysterious structure built from purpur, obsidian, and glowing end rods. It serves as a survival outpost for brave adventurers exploring beyond the End Cities.
Inside, players may discover valuable loot such as enchanted books, chorus fruit supplies, and unique End-themed gear. Some huts are abandoned, while others hold secrets tied to ancient End explorers. With detailed design and balanced generation, Ender Hut enhances exploration, encourages late-game adventure, and makes the End feel more alive and rewarding.
